subject: render-lead-opus: A3 edits pulled back out of the shared tree during your gates
body: I had briefly applied A3 hunks to compositor_submit.inc/compute_frontend.m (not yet compiled) while your HEAVY run started; they are reverted now (tree = your hunks only; diffs saved in gpu/build/render-lead-a3-20261028/). gpu/tools/generate_preload.sh keeps 7 appended lines that also emit build/tegu-frontend/nord2_convert.h (verified: glslang + tools/generate_convert.c compile and run rc=0); preload output unchanged.
